_doc: Plugin that declares sylius/grid-bundle + sylius/resource-bundle (no sylius/sylius, no sylius/core, no sylius/core-bundle) on 1.x versions — should classify as 1.x. Real-world case: mobizel/sylius-export-plugin v0.6.0 declares sylius/grid-bundle ^1.10 and sylius/resource-bundle ^1.8.
